## Checklist

- [ ] `node --test "test/*.test.mjs"` passes
- [ ] Every new user-visible text goes through `t()` and has an entry in each `js/lang-*.js`
- [ ] No `innerHTML` or other HTML injection, no new dependency
- [ ] The protocol is untouched (word lists, code derivation, seal/journal formats), or the change is discussed in an issue
- [ ] For visible changes: screenshots in both languages
